text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the new year, and Mejiro Dober<n>has invited
me to participate in the<n>Mejiro family's first shrine
visit of<n>the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This year's shrine visit feels so<n>different and
exciting with the addition<n>of your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you agree, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why're you asking me? There's<n>nothing
exciting about doing the same<n>old shrine visit every
year...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I guess. Doing annual<n>traditions like this
together is nice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, enough of that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But more importantly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Red bean soup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Red bean soup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I see plenty of treats for sale at<n>this year's
stalls!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say your New Year's<n>resolution is to cut
back on desserts?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, the year has only just begun! I<n>must simply
ensure that I consume<n>less on average throughout
the rest<n>of the year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-is that how it works?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They have such interesting charms<n>nowadays. And
look what protections<n>they offer: "Everything's
Gonna Be<n>All Right." Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Apparently the shrine's been trying<n>to appeal to
young people. Pics of<n>these charms are all over
Umasta!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You sure know a lot, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wonder what the meaning of this<n>one is?
"Party Luck F-R-F-R"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Pffthaha! Sorry, it sounds hilarious<n>when you say it,
Ardan. Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Talk about free-spirited...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They seem to be enjoying<n>themselves quite a bit.
We can't lose<n>out to them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What kind of competition even is<n>this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, what do you think we<n>should do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you even listening to me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Amazake! What a wonderful idea!<n>That certainly will
help warm our<n>hearts and bodies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would you like some too, Dober?<n>There's nothing
better than a cozy<n>shrine visit to start off the year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haha, never heard a shrine visit<n>described as
"cozy" before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they're selling it over<n>there, so let's go
get some.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We all enjoy our amazake and end<n>our shrine visit
feeling very warm and<n>fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A charm! They've piqued my interest<n>too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we all get matching ones<n>to mark the
occasion of our coming<n>here together, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What? I don't know about that... I<n>don't mind
getting one with you,<n>Bright, but all three of us?
That's too<n>embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Really? But isn't getting matching<n>charms a
hallmark of youth? The<n>characters in the manga
you lent me<n>did the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's different! Oh, fine. Whatever!<n>Let's just go
get some!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of our shrine visit<n>deciding which
charm to buy, and<n>ultimately we choose the one for
certain victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's a fabulous place to start. What<n>will you be
wishing for, then?
choice_data_list: For Dober to become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-don't just say it all casually like<n>that! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You never change, do you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Exactly the answer I expected<n>from your
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Exactly the answer I expected<n>from your
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Aren't you supposed to keep<n>your wish a
secret?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you want for something to come<n>true fervently
enough, I don't think it<n>matters if you tell others
about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And knowing your trainer, there<n>won't be a
problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I guess that's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's pray for each other's success<n>in our senior
year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. A wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We all stand in a line and pray for<n>smooth sailing in
their upcoming<n>senior year!
